note: Illustrative worst-case dimensional stack-up only. Values are not Nyfasi specifications, supplier tolerances or manufacturing release limits.

roller_band_to_wall_slot.formula: slot width - band width; worst case = nominal ± (slot_width_tolerance + band_width_tolerance)

spindle_pin_to_elastomer_seal.formula: seal bore diameter - pin diameter; elastomer deformation/contact is not modelled

release_gate: Replace assumptions with calibrated sample measurements or authorised drawings.
Confirm datum scheme and GD&T before tolerancing parts.
Check band/slot minimum clearance over the full roller rotation and axial tolerance stack.
Model elastomer compression, durometer, swelling, wear and fluid compatibility before claiming sealing.
Run physical spin, leak, wear and contamination tests.
